cases.hypothesis: 8 MiB B within 32 MiB L2; very low arithmetic intensity

cases.name: small-tokens
cases.hypothesis: 16 MiB B; more reuse with still sparse M tiles

cases.name: balanced-medium
cases.hypothesis: Tensor Core throughput and CTA occupancy

cases.name: tall
cases.hypothesis: many M tiles, grouped ordering and rectangular reuse

cases.name: decode-beyond-l2
cases.hypothesis: 64 MiB B exceeds L2; memory-sensitive decode

cases.name: irregular
cases.hypothesis: tails in all axes, last partial program group

cases.name: few-tokens-wide
cases.hypothesis: 32 MiB B at L2 boundary, wide output and small M

cases.name: prefill
cases.hypothesis: transition from memory traffic to reuse

cases.name: wide-k-small
cases.hypothesis: wide N / small K; loop overhead and group ordering

l2.prior_cost_notice: Transfer assumes the already collected compatible training labels; target budgets exclude that historical acquisition cost. Deterministic methods do not gain independent evidence from repeated RNG seeds.

prediction.scope: First proposal quality with empty target history; evaluated offline using measured held-out labels. No new GPU execution for prediction.
prediction.notice: 4 test Shapes x 3 physical replicates; existing searchers also have 10 RNG seeds. Deterministic seed repeats are not additional independent experiments. Surrogate has a random cold start. Prior acquisition cost is conditional historical knowledge, not free cold-start tuning.

fresh_online.notice: Random/Heuristic can reproduce proposed config sequences; adaptive Surrogate can branch differently on fresh noisy measurements. GPU timings are fresh observations, Replay timings are prior measured labels.
